|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Passage To The Alderaan System]] (version 3 of 4). The current text is [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]]): the errata card image (25 July 2024, a corrected image (“Passage image fix”))<ref name="ht-1038746">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/103874657ec982c3002d76f0fe3347388d73f573/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/103874657ec982c3002d76f0fe3347388d73f573 1038746] “Passage image fix”, 25 July 2024, a corrected image (“Passage image fix”).</ref> prints: “If Stolen Data Tapes on table, deploy on table. Once per game, may simultaneously deploy non-[Episode VII] Falcon and non-[Episode VII] Han (for -1 Force each) from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At Tatooine system, Imperial starships may not have their deploy cost modified. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The re-made image prints the starship name “Falcon” in italics (the first image printed it in roman type); no errata mark was added. It is a version of its own because it is a separate publication of the card image (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 2 August 2024: “If Stolen Data Tapes on table, deploy on table. Once per game, may simultaneously deploy non-[Episode VII] Falcon and non-[Episode VII] Han (for -1 Force each) from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At Tatooine system, Imperial starships may not have their deploy cost modified. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (repository revision 25 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Passage To The Alderaan System”; the printed face matches the image in visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata 3)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If Stolen Data Tapes on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ a general or a senator. Once per game, may simultaneously deploy [A New Hope] Falcon (deploy -1) and [A New Hope] Han from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Falcon is immune to Gravity Shadow. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-c3e8344">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/c3e8344c98da4264b65cf180188c688d868cda80 swccg-card-json commit c3e8344] “Set 24 Errata - Light (part 2)” (14 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Twice per game, may ▲ a general or a senator.” was added (▲ = take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle); the Falcon/Han deploy changed from “non-[Episode VII] Falcon and non-[Episode VII] Han (for -1 Force each)” to “[A New Hope] Falcon (deploy -1) and [A New Hope] Han”; “At Tatooine system, Imperial starships may not have their deploy cost modified.” was replaced by “Falcon is immune to Gravity Shadow.” The image prints the errata mark “E1”, though it is the second change to the image. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right. '''PC transcription error:''' this image prints the errata mark “E1”, but it is the third image of the card and its second version after the original (PC-E3); the mark does not match the version. The wiki numbers versions by release order and records the printed mark (Bill, 12 November 2026). Listed on [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
